text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to install an accessible loading zone fronting the entrance at Bowmore Road Public School located on the west side of Bowmore Road, south of Gerrard Street East. The accessible loading zone will operate between the hours of 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m., daily, and will provide curb side access for Wheel-Trans fronting the schools entrance.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Designated an accessible loading zone to operate from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., daily on the west side of Bowmore Road, between a point 149 metres south of Gerrard Street East and a point 11.0 metres further south. 2. Amended the no parking prohibition in effect from 9:30 a.m. to 11:30 a.m., and from 1:30 p.m. to 3:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Bowmore Road, between a point 130 metres south of Gerrard Street East and a point 30 metres further south, to be in effect between a point 130 metres south of Gerrard street East and a point 19 metres further south. 3.
